posts.zh:
dsh-oomol 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。将 DeepSeek Harness 接入由 OOMOL 管理的应用与服务，支持渐进式发现并执行 Connector Actions，并提供用于管理 Provider 连接的应用内面板。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-aaf99f7738371ef016c4.html
posts.en:
dsh-oomol is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Connects DeepSeek Harness to OOMOL-managed apps and services, with progressive Connector Action discovery and execution plus an in-app panel for managing Provider connections.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-aaf99f7738371ef016c4.html
